_comment: DRISHTI Catalyst Signals registry (Phase 14 Part B + H scoping). Signals is CONSOLE-ONLY (no SDK/API to create publishers/rules/webhooks), so this is the reviewed source an operator recreates in Console -> Signals. H MINIMAL SET: enable exactly ONE rule for the hackathon - 'prediction-requested' -> prediction_event (the one prediction.requested Signal/Event Function). Every other rule is tier=optional (documented but Inactive); Mail/Push rules (report/notify/signup) belong to Prompt 15. All rules stay active=false and cost nothing until their owning phase enables them + the matching AppSail DRISHTI_*_ENABLED flag is set. Authoritative record is always persisted BEFORE the event is emitted (a Data Store row_inserted trigger fires only after the row is committed; the custom drishti_app publisher is emitted only after the AppSail transaction commits).

minimal_set.note: One prediction.requested Signal/Event Function is the only event kept for the hackathon; see cron-schedules.json for the one minimal forecast cron.

publishers.note: Emitted by AppSail ONLY after the authoritative transaction commits (persist-before-emit). Phase 15 adds report.ready / prediction.reviewed / notification.created / task.escalated via services/ml/app/signals.py, all gated by DRISHTI_SIGNALS_ENABLED (off by default).

dlq_equivalent: Undelivered events move to Dropped after TTL; monitored in Console -> Signals -> Logs. A failed prediction_event marks the PredictionRequest Status='failed' (failed-job state) so a rerun is controlled.

rules.name: prediction-requested
rules.note: THE one kept Signal/Event (H). Fires after the PredictionRequest row is committed; the function dispatches to the protected AWS adapter and, on failure, sets Status='failed' with retry per retry_policy.

rules.name: canonical-version-committed
rules.note: OPTIONAL (H). The AppSail runtime can persist the FeatureSnapshot + PredictionRequest inline, so a separate canonical-version event is not required for the demo.

rules.name: prediction-result-ready
rules.note: OPTIONAL (H). Result-ready notice reaches the UI via Gateway polling or the scoped SSE channel; a separate Signal is not required.

rules.name: evidence-uploaded
rules.note: OPTIONAL (H) - a separate event per upload action is deferred.

rules.name: report-ready
rules.note: Phase 15 IMPLEMENTED. reports.service publishes report.ready AFTER the ReportSnapshot Data Store write commits (data-minimized: ids + hashes only). Emission is gated by DRISHTI_SIGNALS_ENABLED so the demo is cost-free by default.

rules.name: prediction-reviewed
rules.note: Phase 15 IMPLEMENTED. governance.review publishes prediction.reviewed AFTER the review transaction commits (decision/status only, no model output).

rules.name: notification-created
rules.note: Phase 15 IMPLEMENTED. notifications.deliver_notification publishes notification.created AFTER the NotificationMessage write commits; Mail/Push delivery is additionally gated by DRISHTI_NOTIFY_ENABLED. Bodies are data-minimized synthetic summaries only.

rules.name: task-escalated
rules.note: Phase 15 IMPLEMENTED. notifications.run_escalations publishes task.escalated AFTER a WorkTask crosses its SLA and is escalated (task id/type only).

deferred_capabilities.circuits: Branch/parallel Circuits orchestration is DEFERRED (also unavailable in the IN DC); the one prediction.requested Signal + idempotent Functions + the one forecast cron replace it.
deferred_capabilities.per_action_events: Separate events for every upload/import/report action are DEFERRED (optional rules above).
deferred_capabilities.mail_push: Mail + Push notifications are IMPLEMENTED in Phase 15 (services/ml/app/notify_channels.py, data-minimized) and gated by DRISHTI_NOTIFY_ENABLED (off by default so the demo is cost-free; in-app notifications always work).
deferred_capabilities.multiple_crons_backfills: Multiple cron schedules + backfill pipelines are DEFERRED (see cron-schedules.json).
